name: Forge Platform
description: Workbench, editor, settings and the plugin system.

settings.title: Changed shortcuts (Windows / Linux)
settings.description: One entry per action: the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs.

settings.title: Changed shortcuts (macOS)
settings.description: One entry per action: the action id, then its shortcuts, separated by tabs.

settings.title: Font
settings.description: Font used for menus, tool windows and dialogs.

settings.title: Compact mode
settings.description: Reduces paddings and the height of toolbars and tool window headers.

settings.title: Show tool window bars
settings.description: The stripes with tool window buttons along the window edges.

settings.title: Main menu
settings.description: Hamburger menu: behind the button at the left of the main toolbar. Merged: the menu names in the main toolbar. Separate toolbar: a classic menu bar above the main toolbar.

settings.title: Smooth scrolling
settings.description: Animate scrolling in lists and trees.

settings.title: Show splash screen on startup
settings.description: The Forge wordmark fills with molten metal while the IDE loads, and offers updates.

settings.title: Window controls
settings.description: Look of the title bar buttons of the main window and dialogs. "Native" lets the operating system draw the title bar.

settings.title: Open files with single click
settings.description: In the Project tool window a single click opens files and expands folders. Turn it off to select with a single click and open with a double click, like PHPStorm.

settings.title: Template data languages
settings.description: Language of the content between template tags, one entry per pattern: `legacy/latex/*.tpl=latex`, `*.mail.twig=text`. Languages: html, xml, latex, css, scss, less, javascript, typescript, json, sql, yaml, ini, shell, text. Compound names like `invoice.tex.twig` are detected automatically. Applies to files opened afterwards.

settings.title: Left delimiter
settings.description: Smarty's left_delimiter. Use e.g. `<{` for LaTeX templates, where `{` is part of the content.

settings.title: Default project directory
settings.description: New projects are created here unless you pick another location.

settings.title: Save files if the IDE is switched to a different application
Save files if the IDE is idle
Synchronize external changes when switching to the IDE window
Check for updates on startup
settings.description: The splash screen checks at most once a day. Help | Check for Updates… checks at any time.

settings.title: Update channel
settings.description: Beta also offers pre-releases.

settings.title: Update feed URL
settings.description: The latest.json of the update feed. Empty: the GitHub releases of Forge for the selected channel. Updates must be signed with the key this build was made with.

settings.title: Soft-wrap files
settings.description: Wrap long lines visually in files matching the patterns below.

settings.title: Ensure every saved file ends with a line break
Enable ligatures
settings.description: Render character sequences like -> and !== as a single glyph if the font supports it.

settings.title: Visual guides
settings.description: Comma-separated column numbers, e.g. 80, 120.

settings.title: Parameter names
settings.description: Show parameter names at call sites for literal and null arguments.

settings.title: Usages
settings.description: Show the number of usages above classes and methods (Code Vision).

settings.title: Environment
settings.description: Environment of http-client.env.json (and http-client.private.env.json) that requests of .http files run with. Empty: dev, else the first one; $none: no environment. Chosen in the toolbar of .http editors.

name: Git
description: Commit, branches, log, diff and merge conflicts for Git repositories.

settings.title: Path to Git executable
settings.description: Leave as `git` to use the one on PATH.

settings.title: Require blank line between subject and body
Warn if CRLF line separators are about to be committed

name: GitLab, Forgejo and GitHub
description: Merge and pull requests, code review, issues and CI pipelines for GitLab, Forgejo/Gitea and GitHub.

settings.title: Show the CI status of the current branch in the status bar
Refresh merge requests and pipelines every (seconds)
settings.description: 0 turns automatic refresh off.

name: Terminal
description: Integrated terminal emulator with shell integration.

settings.title: Shell path
settings.description: Leave empty to use the system default shell.

settings.title: Shell integration
settings.description: Track the working directory and command boundaries of supported shells.

settings.title: Start directory
settings.description: Leave empty to start in the project root.

settings.title: Environment variables
settings.description: One NAME=value pair per entry.

name: Run/Debug
description: Run/Debug configurations, the Run tool window and shell script configurations.

runConfigurationTypes.name: Shell Script
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run a script file or a script text with a shell.

name: Database Tools and SQL
description: Data sources, SQL consoles, schema browsing and table editing for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite.

settings.title: Result set page size
settings.description: Rows fetched per page in consoles and table editors.

settings.title: Suggest data sources from .env files
settings.description: Offer to add the database configured in Laravel's DB_* or Symfony's DATABASE_URL.

name: Docker and Kubernetes
description: Services tool window: Docker containers, images, volumes and networks, Docker Compose projects and Kubernetes workloads, with logs, exec and gutter ▶ for compose files and Dockerfiles.

settings.title: Socket path
settings.description: Unix socket (e.g. /var/run/docker.sock, ~/.docker/run/docker.sock) or named pipe (\\.\pipe\docker_engine). Empty: the first existing default.

settings.title: Engine API URL
settings.description: For TCP connections, e.g. tcp://192.168.1.20:2376.

settings.title: Certificates folder
settings.description: Folder with ca.pem, cert.pem and key.pem (like DOCKER_CERT_PATH).

settings.title: SSH host
settings.description: For SSH connections: ssh://user@host[:port] or a Host alias of ~/.ssh/config. Keys come from the ssh-agent and ~/.ssh; the host key must be in known_hosts.

settings.title: Docker socket on the host
settings.description: Empty: /var/run/docker.sock (rootless: /run/user/<uid>/docker.sock).

settings.title: Docker context
settings.description: For Docker context connections: a context of `docker context ls` (~/.docker/contexts).

settings.title: Docker executable
settings.description: Used for docker compose, image builds and exec terminals.

settings.title: Show the last log lines
settings.description: Lines loaded when a Log tab opens; new lines follow.

settings.title: Registry accounts
settings.description: One entry per registry: server, a tab, the user name. Passwords are kept in the OS keychain.

settings.title: Kubeconfig file
settings.description: Empty: $KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.

settings.title: Default context
settings.description: Empty: the kubeconfig's current-context.

settings.title: Default namespace
settings.description: Empty: the context's namespace, else default.

settings.title: kubectl executable
settings.description: Used for exec terminals in pods.

name: PHP
description: PHP language support: completion, inspections, navigation and refactorings via Intelephense.

settings.title: PHP language level
settings.description: Inspections and completion follow the syntax of this version.

settings.title: CLI Interpreter
settings.description: Path to the php executable used to run scripts and tests.

settings.title: Include path
settings.description: Extra directories indexed as libraries (e.g. global PEAR or framework stubs).

settings.title: Default stubs path
settings.description: A phpstorm-stubs checkout used for PHP's own classes, functions and constants (Go to Declaration on \Throwable, array_map). Empty: Forge downloads JetBrains' phpstorm-stubs into its cache folder on first use, or uses Intelephense's stubs.

settings.title: Language server
settings.description: Started automatically when a PHP project opens.

settings.title: When Intelephense is not installed
settings.description: Forge downloads Intelephense from the npm registry into its own directory (and Node.js when none is installed). Intelephense is not bundled with Forge.

options.label: Ask when a PHP project opens

settings.title: I accept the Intelephense licence
settings.description: Asked once before Forge downloads Intelephense for you. Its licence (LICENSE.txt in the npm package, intelephense.com) applies to your copy.

settings.title: Keep maximum blank lines in code

runConfigurationTypes.name: PHP Script
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run a PHP file with the CLI interpreter.

name: Language Servers
description: Detects, installs and starts language servers for JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue, Python, Go, Rust, Lua, YAML and 25 more languages.

settings.title: Start language servers for languages found in the project
settings.description: Servers start lazily when the first matching file is opened.

settings.title: Files scanned to detect languages
settings.description: Ignored files (.gitignore), node_modules and vendor are skipped.

settings.title: Suggest installing missing language servers
settings.description: Shows a banner in files that use a feature only a language server provides, such as a JSON $schema, when that server is not installed.

settings.title: Servers not suggested again
settings.description: Server ids whose banner was turned off with "Don't show again". Remove an entry to get the suggestion back.

settings.title: Lua environment
settings.description: Adds the APIs and globals of LÖVE (love.*) or Neovim (vim.*) to lua-language-server. Detected from conf.lua, main.lua or init.lua with a lua/ folder.

settings.title: Lua version
settings.description: Used with Plain Lua; LÖVE and Neovim run LuaJIT.

settings.title: Check for updates of servers installed by Forge once a day
settings.description: Offers an update when the npm registry has a newer version of a server in Forge's server directory.

settings.title: npm registry
settings.description: Where Forge downloads npm language servers from. Every tarball is checked against the registry's sha512 integrity hash.

settings.title: Node.js download mirror
settings.description: Used only when no Node.js 18 or newer is installed. Downloads are checked against the release's SHASUMS256.txt.

name: Composer
description: composer.json support, dependency install/update and autoload-aware indexing.

settings.title: Path to composer
settings.description: A composer executable or composer.phar.

settings.title: Synchronize IDE settings with composer.json
settings.description: Language level and source roots follow `require.php` and `autoload`.

settings.title: Check for package updates on project open

name: PHPUnit
description: Run, debug and navigate PHPUnit and Pest tests.

runConfigurationTypes.name: PHPUnit
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run a test class, method, directory or phpunit.xml configuration.

name: Xdebug
description: Step debugging with Xdebug 3 via DBGp.

commands.title: Start Listening for PHP Debug Connections

settings.title: Debug port
settings.description: Forge listens here for Xdebug (xdebug.client_port, 9003 by default).

settings.title: Ignore external connections through unregistered server configurations
settings.description: Connections that match no server and no project file are detached silently.

settings.title: Break at first line in PHP scripts
Step out of files that are not mapped into the project
settings.description: Stepping never stops in code without a local file (e.g. PHAR internals or eval'd code).

settings.title: Show variable values in editor while debugging
Max. children
settings.description: Array elements and object properties loaded per page.

settings.title: Max. depth
settings.description: Nesting levels fetched at once; deeper levels load when expanded.

settings.title: Max. string length
settings.description: Bytes of string data fetched per value.

name: Laravel
description: Routes, Blade, Eloquent and artisan integration.

settings.title: Read routes from
settings.description: php artisan route:list also sees routes registered by packages, but needs a bootable application.

options.label: artisan route:list when available, else route files

settings.title: Complete routes, views, config, translations and model attributes
Complete database columns in query builder calls
settings.description: where(), orderBy(), pluck() and similar, with columns read from the migrations.

settings.title: Show route icons for controller actions
Show view icons for view() calls and Blade includes
Additional Blade directives
settings.description: Directive names without @, e.g. datetime. They are highlighted and completed like built-in ones.

runConfigurationTypes.name: Artisan
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run an artisan command of a Laravel application.

name: Symfony
description: Services, routing, Twig templates and console commands.

settings.title: Environment
settings.description: Kernel environment used for the compiled container and console commands.

settings.title: App directory
settings.description: Scanned for controllers, console commands and Twig extensions.

settings.title: Console
settings.description: Path to the console script, relative to the project root.

settings.title: Container XML
settings.description: Compiled container dump; leave empty to use var/cache/<environment>/*Container.xml.

settings.title: Show line markers for routes, templates and commands
Complete Twig tags, filters and functions

name: Symfony Services
description: services.yaml: service, parameter and tag completion, @service and %parameter% highlighting.

name: Doctrine
description: Entity mapping, repositories and DQL completion.

settings.title: Entity source directories
settings.description: Scanned for #[ORM\Entity] classes and repositories.

settings.title: Mapping file directories
settings.description: Directories with *.orm.xml and *.orm.yml mapping files.

settings.title: Read legacy @ORM annotations
settings.description: Docblock annotations are used when a class has no mapping attributes.

settings.title: Highlight DQL in createQuery() and QueryBuilder strings
Complete entities, aliases and fields in DQL

name: HTML, CSS & JavaScript
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript editing with language servers, npm scripts and package managers.

settings.title: Package manager
settings.description: Auto uses the packageManager field of package.json, else the lock file (pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock, package-lock.json).

settings.title: Show run icons next to scripts in package.json
Node options when debugging scripts
settings.description: Set as NODE_OPTIONS for Debug; attach Chrome DevTools or another inspector client to the port.

settings.title: Navigate from JSX and template tags to components, props and events
settings.description: Ctrl+B and Ctrl+Click on <UserCard>, title=… and @select resolve through imports before the language server is asked.

name: React
description: JSX components and props: navigation from tags to components and from components to their usages.

name: Vue.js
description: Single-file components via the Vue language server, with navigation to components, props and emits.

name: Angular
description: Components, directives and pipes: selector, binding and pipe navigation, template and style line markers.

settings.title: Show line markers between components, templates and styles

name: Lua
description: Lua 5.1–5.4 and LuaJIT: EmmyLua/LuaLS annotations, navigation, structure, LÖVE and Neovim, lua-language-server and StyLua.

settings.title: Lua interpreter
settings.description: Runs Lua Script configurations that do not set their own: lua, luajit, love or a full path.

settings.title: Module search paths
settings.description: package.path templates relative to the project, such as scripts/?.lua. Used to resolve require("a.b"); ?.lua, ?/init.lua, lua/?.lua, src/?.lua and lib/?.lua are always tried.

settings.title: lua-language-server executable
settings.description: Leave empty to find it on PATH, in Mason or in Forge's server directory.

settings.title: Library paths
settings.description: Extra folders with Lua definitions or third-party code (workspace.library), e.g. ~/.luarocks/share/lua/5.4.

settings.title: Reformat Code with StyLua
settings.description: Ctrl+Alt+L formats Lua files with StyLua when it is installed; stylua.toml in the project is honoured.

runConfigurationTypes.name: Lua Script
runConfigurationTypes.description: Run a Lua file (or a LÖVE game directory) with the configured interpreter.

description: Chat, inline completions and code generation with your own model providers.

chatAgents.name: Assistant
chatAgents.description: General chat about the open project.

name: Claude Code
description: Run Claude Code agents in the IDE, several in parallel.

settings.title: Claude Code executable
settings.description: Leave empty to find claude on PATH.

settings.title: Default permission mode
settings.description: How much the agent may do before asking. Can be changed per chat.

chatAgents.name: Claude Code
chatAgents.description: Agentic coding in your project, using the local `claude` CLI.

description: Chat with Gemini CLI agents in the IDE, using your own Gemini CLI login.

settings.title: Gemini CLI executable
settings.description: Leave empty to find gemini on PATH.

chatAgents.name: Gemini CLI
chatAgents.description: Agentic coding in your project, using the local `gemini` CLI.

name: Bash
description: Shell scripts and dotfiles: highlighting, completion of builtins, functions and variables, and folding. bash-language-server comes from Settings > Language Servers.

name: Python
description: Python editing with scope-aware completion and and syntax checks. Pyright and other servers come from Settings > Language Servers.

name: YAML
description: YAML editing with folding and syntax checks. yaml-language-server comes from Settings > Language Servers.

name: JSON
description: JSON and JSON with comments: highlighting, folding and syntax checks. With vscode-json-language-server (Settings > Language Servers), `$schema` (local file or URL) drives validation, completion and hover.

name: .env
description: dotenv files: keys, quoted values and ${VAR} interpolation, with checks for unquoted spaces, unterminated quotes and duplicate keys.

name: Ignore Files
description: .gitignore, .dockerignore, .npmignore and friends. Files ignored by git are grayed out in the Project view.

name: Docker
description: Dockerfile and Docker Compose: instruction and Compose Specification completion, hover documentation and checks.

name: Postfix
description: Postfix main.cf and master.cf: parameter and restriction completion with documentation, lookup table types and checks.

name: E-Mail
description: RFC 5322 messages (.eml): headers, MIME parts, encoded words and quoted replies.

name: INI
description: INI files (php.ini, .editorconfig, .gitconfig, systemd units): sections, keys, values, folding and checks for broken sections and duplicate keys.

name: Config Files
description: Generic .conf files: key/value pairs, comments, interpolation and nginx-style blocks.

name: Browser Companion
description: Click a component in the browser to open its source, forge:// links for error pages (Ignition, Symfony, Xdebug) and the forge file:line launcher.

settings.title: Accept open requests from paired browsers
settings.description: Runs a small server on 127.0.0.1 that only paired browser extensions can use.

settings.title: Port
settings.description: If the port is taken (for example by PhpStorm), the next 9 ports are tried. The extension finds Forge in this range.

settings.title: Bring Forge to the front when a file is opened
